title: English Around the World
text:
English is spoken by millions of people around the world. Many of them do not speak it as their first language. People use English to talk to friends from other countries, to study, and to work. Because of this, English is often called a global language.

English is important on the internet, in airports, and in science. Many scientific papers are written in English, so researchers from different countries can read them. Some people learn English because they want better jobs. Others learn it simply because they love the language.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do people use English for?
options: To cook food and play sports
To talk to friends from other countries, to study, and to work
To write letters to the government

questions.text: According to paragraph two, why are many scientific papers written in English?
options: So that children can learn to read
So that researchers from different countries can read them
Because English books are cheaper to print
Because scientists do not speak other languages

questions.text: Why is English called a global language?
options: Only people in one country speak it
It is used by people in many countries
It is easy to learn for everyone
It was invented in a laboratory

questions.text: What can you infer about someone who learns English to get a better job?
options: They do not like learning languages
They think English can help their career
They already speak English very well
They only read English books for fun

paragraph_translations: El inglés lo hablan millones de personas en todo el mundo. Muchas de ellas no lo hablan como su primera lengua. La gente usa el inglés para hablar con amigos de otros países, para estudiar y para trabajar. Por eso, el inglés se llama a menudo una lengua global.

El inglés es importante en internet, en los aeropuertos y en la ciencia. Muchos artículos científicos están escritos en inglés, así que los investigadores de distintos países pueden leerlos. Algunas personas aprenden inglés porque quieren mejores trabajos. Otras lo aprenden simplemente porque les encanta el idioma.
